observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge functions as a coercive pressure tactic — the speaker demands compliance with a deletion directive, no rationale offered.
Bare imperative to purge information, repeated demand pattern with src-1, reinforcing coercive pressure without consultation or justification.

mints.name: DeletionDirective
mints.title: imperative command to erase or remove knowledge, issued without rationale
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting authority through a bare demand to delete or forget, rather than through argument or consultation?
